name: Three timeframes
summary: This EA analyzes market conditions across three different timeframes to generate trading signals, using a multi-timeframe convergence approach. It typically combines trend direction from a higher timeframe, momentum confirmation from a middle timeframe, and entry timing from a lower timeframe. Trades are opened only when all three timeframe signals align, reducing false entries.
summary_zh: 该EA通过分析三个不同周期的市场条件来生成交易信号，采用多周期共振方法。通常结合高周期趋势方向、中周期动量确认和低周期入场时机，仅当三个周期信号一致时才开仓，从而减少虚假入场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是多周期共振确认，通过在三个不同时间周期上分析市场来提高信号的可靠性。高周期用于判断主趋势方向，中周期用于确认动量是否与趋势一致，低周期用于精确入场时机。入场条件要求三个周期的信号必须同时满足一致方向才会触发交易，这种多重过滤机制有效减少了单一周期信号的假突破风险。出场条件通常基于反向信号出现或固定的止损止盈设置，但具体逻辑取决于参数配置。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算方式。资金管理上存在一定不足，缺乏最大回撤控制或动态仓位调整机制，建议增加更完善的风险控制模块。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is multi-timeframe convergence confirmation, analyzing the market across three different timeframes to enhance signal reliability. The higher timeframe is used to determine the main trend direction, the middle timeframe confirms whether momentum aligns with the trend, and the lower timeframe provides precise entry timing. Entry conditions require all three timeframe signals to align in the same direction before a trade is triggered, and this multi-filter mechanism effectively reduces the risk of false breakouts from single-timeframe signals. Exit conditions are typically based on the appearance of reverse signals or fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, depending on parameter configuration. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or balance-based dynamic lot calculation. Money management has some shortcomings, lacking maximum drawdown control or dynamic position adjustment mechanisms, and adding a more comprehensive risk control module is recommended.

pros: 多周期共振确认大幅降低了假信号率，三个周期对齐才入场是稳健的方法
分层次分析市场结构（趋势-动量-入场），逻辑清晰且符合技术分析原理
参数化设计允许用户灵活调整各周期和风控参数，适应不同交易品种和风格
pros_en: Multi-timeframe convergence significantly reduces false signal rate, requiring alignment across three timeframes is a robust approach
Layered market structure analysis (trend-momentum-entry) follows clear logic consistent with technical analysis principles
Parameterized design allows flexible adjustment of timeframes and risk controls to suit different instruments and trading styles
cons: 三周期同时共振的信号可能较少，在震荡行情中容易长时间无交易
止损止盈为固定点数设置，未考虑ATR等波动性指标，在不同市场条件下适应性不足
缺乏仓位比例管理和最大回撤控制，资金管理模块较为简单
cons_en: Three-timeframe convergence signals may be infrequent, potentially leading to long periods without trades during ranging markets
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit in pips does not account for volatility indicators like ATR, reducing adaptability across market conditions
Lacks proportional position sizing and maximum drawdown control, making the money management module relatively simple
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈机制，使风控参数能自适应市场波动性
添加最大回撤限制和仓位比例控制，提升资金管理安全性
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit mechanism so risk parameters can adapt to market volatility
Add maximum drawdown limits and proportional position sizing controls to improve capital management safety

risk_points: 固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动性变化，在高波动时段可能止损过小导致频繁被扫
缺乏最大回撤控制和仓位比例管理，在连续亏损时风险敞口无法自动缩减
risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss/take-profit does not adapt to volatility changes, potentially causing frequent stop-outs during high-volatility periods
Lack of maximum drawdown control and proportional position sizing means risk exposure cannot auto-reduce during consecutive losses
